# Official Beige Book test excerpts

Retrieved 2026-10-14 from:
- https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/beigebook202610-summary.htm
- https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/beigebook202608-summary.htm
- https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/publications/beige-book-default.htm

Summary fixtures retain the three national sections and the information-cutoff note.
The index fixture retains the two explicit release labels and year heading.
Navigation and district highlights are deliberately excluded. These are frozen
parser regression fixtures, not a claim that economic wording will always follow
the supported patterns. Future unrecognized numbers remain null.
